summary: CREATE ASSIGNMENT is a workload management DCL statement for creating reservation assignments in BigQuery.
extended_definition: CREATE ASSIGNMENT is a workload management DCL statement for creating reservation assignments in BigQuery.

supporting_pages.title: "Data definition language (DDL) statements in GoogleSQL \_|\_ BigQuery \_\
evidence_snippets: Example The following example assigns the project my project to the prod reservation for query jobs: CREATE ASSIGNMENT admin project.region-us.prod.my assignment OPTIONS ( assignee = 'projects/my project' , job type = 'QUERY' ); The following example assigns an organization to the prod reservation for pipeline jobs, such as load and extract jobs: CREATE ASSIGNMENT admin project.region-us.prod.my assignment OPTIONS ( assignee = 'organizations/1234' , job type = 'PIPELINE' ); CREATE SEARCH INDEX statement Creates a new search index on one or more columns of a table.

Syntax DROP ASSIGNMENT [ IF EXISTS ] project id . location . reservation id . assignment id Arguments IF EXISTS : If no assignment exists with that ID, the statement has no effect. project id : The project ID of the administration project where the reservation was created. location : The location of the reservation. reservation id : The reservation ID. assignment id : The assignment ID.

Example The following example creates a reservation of 100 slots in the project admin project : CREATE RESERVATION admin project.region-us.prod OPTIONS ( slot capacity = 100 ); CREATE ASSIGNMENT statement Assigns a project, folder, or organization to a reservation.

supporting_pages.title: "Stream table updates with change data capture ingestion \_|\_ BigQuery \_\
evidence_snippets: Once you have created a reservation, assign the BigQuery project to the reservation, and set the job type option to BACKGROUND by running the following CREATE ASSIGNMENT statement : CREATE ASSIGNMENT ADMIN PROJECT ID .region- REGION .

The following example creates the table employees with a max staleness limit of 10 minutes: CREATE TABLE employees ( id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED , name STRING ) CLUSTER BY id OPTIONS ( max staleness = INTERVAL 10 MINUTE ); Modify the max staleness option for an existing table To add or modify a max staleness limit in an existing table, use the ALTER TABLE statement .
ASSIGNMENT ID OPTIONS ( assignee = 'projects/ PROJECT ID ' , job type = 'BACKGROUND' ); Replace the following: ADMIN PROJECT ID : the ID of the administration project that owns the reservation.
